liveMap.geometry: Integer 16px ground tiles; all heroes use native 16x32 frames anchored bottom-center on the actual player tile.
liveMap.knowledge: Remembered terrain; only occupants/objects supplied in the current public observation. No persistent occupant cache or hidden species inference.
liveMap.movement: No art controller, pathfinding, collision or game rules. Named library operations own all game behavior.
liveMap.symbols: Original art in src/symbol-art.ts and src/encounter-art.ts; original glyphs retained in inspection, text map and optional symbol mode. No hidden species/item identity inference.
